report:
Reviewed the complete isolated-completion claim, all five ordinary implementation associations (expression checking, external signature matching, commit_branch, finalize, finish), the ordinary regression, and the explicit TODO test. Added direct associations for the essential method and inference-context boundaries before restarting this review. No N/A evidence is present.

Isolation: expr.rs dispatches method calls through resolve_method; method.rs checks metadata eligibility and arity before instantiation. instantiate_external_inherent_signature allocates generics in a child of ROOT, relates receiver and each argument there, and discards the entire child when any relation fails. It builds the obligation batch only after successful matching, commits the child, and publishes the batch before returning the selected signature. Thus failed matching cannot publish its environment. commit_branch rebuilds the child, collapses its complete state, then publishes wake effects. Captured egraph helpers require an exclusive direct leaf child, transfer equality/bound/domain/dependency/work/wake state and variable ownership together, and erase discarded states. Captured try_unify_batch/try_probe show structural relations also run inside child transactions and discard on failure. types_may_unify always discards its probe. The linked RFD distinguishes these short-lived probes from isolated concurrent solver contexts; these checker boundaries do not merge competing candidate contexts into the caller.

Completion: finalize first processes ready obligations, defaults deferred never targets and remaining bounds, diagnoses unresolved variables, retries obligations after fallback, and runs mandatory terminal discharge. Proof Maybe and residual conditions become diagnostics in the terminal pass; normalization has corresponding terminal failure handling. It drains pending wakes/runtime after terminal processing. finish asserts no pending obligations, live ROOT child, runtime task/ready entry, or unpublished wake, and only then produces the frozen CheckedBody. The captured function-body caller runs finalize before finish. Captured Runtime::is_quiescent checks both tasks and ready queue. Terminal obligation records can remain as historical records; the claim requires no live work, not deleting terminal records.

Test adequacy: external_method_mismatch_discards_partial_generic_bindings constructs an external owner generic T and method generic E with parameters E,bool, supplies an inference variable followed by char, asserts rejection, asserts Bound::None for the caller variable, and asserts unchanged root semantic revision. This meaningfully detects leaked partial generic inference on failure. It does not assert wake or obligation rollback, successful atomic publication, fallback terminal diagnostics, or complete runtime/transaction quiescence. The explicitly TODO checking_body_isolated_completion lists these outstanding matrix scenarios; its empty body is not behavioral evidence. Accept that visible deferral: prerequisite work is constructing rejected/accepted candidate fixtures with observable wake/obligation effects and completion fixtures exposing runtime, wake, pending-obligation and branch state. The ordinary regression closes only the partial-generic-binding portion; broader verification remains deferred, not claimed complete.

Executed cargo fmt and cargo test -p sage-ir --lib check::method::tests::external_method_mismatch_discards_partial_generic_bindings -- --exact: one test passed, zero failed. Source inspection establishes the implementation assessment; that test run establishes only its narrow rollback scenario. Workspace build is coordinated separately. No behavioral production changes were made and no additional requested edits remain.
